product: <product name shown on the ledger, e.g. Payments API>

jira.review_status: <status that means waiting for code review, e.g. Code Review>
jira.deployment: <server | cloud — omit to infer from the URL>
jira.qa_status: <status a PASS moves to, e.g. In QA>
qa_path: <intermediate statuses when there is no direct move, in order; [] if none>
rework_targets: <transition name or status a FAIL moves to>

git.base_branch: <branch PRs target, e.g. main or develop>
git.host: <bitbucket | github — omit to infer from the remote>
git.api_base: <only for a self-hosted instance; omit for bitbucket.org / github.com>
protected_branches: <branch names never taken as a feature branch; base_branch is always excluded>

tracking.artifact_url: <omit to use the plugin's shared ledger; set to point this repo at a different ledger page>
